series.scope: Nikon-branded FX photography lens models, with one optical position per Project

collection.source_basis: The MIT-licensed corpus supplies surface radii, axial thicknesses, refractive indices, Abbe numbers, element outlines and stop planes. Each Project models one optical position using catalog glass approximations and derived apertures. A cited patent is a reference from the corpus file.
collection.redistribution: MIT (see licenses/FlareSim-MIT.txt); the repository's MIT licence covers the records.

hashing.source_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the corpus file's bytes as the pinned revision stores them
hashing.project_sha256: SHA-256 of the committed project.json bytes, UTF-8, LF, one trailing newline
hashing.record_hash: SHA-256 over the record's JSON with record_hash and record_hash_method removed: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) as UTF-8, no trailing newline

acceptance.rule: For each source position, the batch screened Engine acceptance, solid validity, agreement with source focal length, chief-ray arrival at modeled samples, and absolute distortion at those samples. Identical native Projects are represented by one accepted record.
